title: The App That Puts Families First
quote: "Communication is a basic human right. VoiceBridge ensures every child can be heard."

builtForFamilies.title: Built for Families
builtForFamilies.description: Designed with input from parents, caregivers, and special education professionals. Every feature serves a real family need — not a checkbox.

clinicallyInformed.title: Clinically Informed
clinicallyInformed.description: Our card library and communication models are informed by evidence-based AAC research and refined through feedback from practicing speech-language pathologists.

privacyFirst.title: Privacy First
privacyFirst.description: Your child's communication data belongs to you. We never sell data, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties — ever. COPPA compliant.

alwaysImproving.title: Always Improving
alwaysImproving.description: VoiceBridge is actively developed with regular updates based on family feedback. New cards, languages, and features are continuously being added.
